method: Fresh 600px contact sheets for all 299 files (35 sheets); a shortlist of 136 viewed at 1000px; 100% crops on 16 subjects (four to an image). Ratings below 3 from the sheets were not recorded frame by frame. Instagram evidence from the vault note: two posts, five frames, all selected.

frames.critique: Old Quarter street, red bunting, fruit vendor in nón lá; busy but the vendor anchors it; good opener. Foreground head bottom-left intrudes slightly.
Mimosa shop front, lanterns; busy, signage-heavy (Factory MADE ad), people cut at bottom. Tourist-shop record.
(posted) Hoàn Kiếm, tree arching over water, clock tower; calm, soft green, haze. Quiet.
(posted) tree over lake, áo dài couple red/white on bank w/ reflection; small figures; pleasant.

frames.focusAt: the tree is sharp, the woman is out of focus by design
frames.critique: Woman in white áo dài with daisies, from behind, under branches over the lake. The mood is right, but the tree is sharp and she is not, and the office block behind breaks the calm. Selected as the softer counterpoint to 7498.
pink fountain grass, shallow focus, people blurred behind; texture piece.
The Huc bridge framed by branches, red reflection; classic but well framed. Haze.
(posted cover?) Turtle Tower framed by branches, reflection; skyscraper left is a blemish.
Young woman in pink áo dài with daisies, laughing, by the big tree roots. A real moment; the face is sharp. Marigolds bottom left and a light fixture bottom right are minor.
St Joseph B&W, clock+cross+statue; tight crop
St Joseph B&W, better: more cross headroom, symmetric. 7507/7508 twins -> 7508.

A cat sitting on patterned cement tiles in a pool of light, the gilded altar behind. Strong graphic frame; the eye is sharp. Has no natural chapter (19:02 on the 24th, between the lake and Train Street).
Hanoi 1930 building at night; record, signage-heavy.
Huc bridge red at night through trees, bench people, lamp; busy but atmosphere. Dirt foreground large.
lake at night, lit trees, Turtle tower distant; calm.
Huc bridge red at night under arching branch, reflection; best night lake.
Turtle tower at night through branches; green water color cast. Twin-ish to 7567.
St Joseph at night, HDR-ish, crowd at bottom; 7575 darker twin. Pick 7574? both a bit grungy.
twin.
Train Street lanterns/fairy lights, people on tracks; vivid, good depth.
street with pink lit tree, cars foreground; busy, square.
Train street, lanterns and lights overhead, tracks leading; twin-ish of 7588 (posted?).
lanterns overhead, abstract vertical; nice colour.
train approaching, phones up, square; the moment.

frames.focusAt: motion blur on the train; the point of the frame
frames.critique: train passing blur, women filming on bench; motion blur intended. Strong.
Train street from above through orange lanterns; great.
Temple of Literature gate (Văn Miếu); flags right; record establishing.
(posted) Khuê Văn Các pavilion under tree, lawn; green.
pavilion looking up, washed sky, CCTV camera on rail; weak.
(posted) Thiên Quang well, marigolds foreground;
pavilion over pond, plants foreground; similar to 7644 but with water.
bonsai in carved stone planter, tiled roof; nice detail.
bonsai, wider, with miniature pagoda; better than 7667 (twins -> 7669). Banner left a little busy.
hanging lantern in dark hall, low-key; moody, plain.
altar hall: bronze crane, gold-character board, woman in courtyard light; layered, good light.
statue of Confucius/Chu Văn An with lilies; dark, foreground blur lily top-left intrudes.
dragon roof ridge, terracotta tiles, horizontal; nice detail, sky flat.
Huc bridge night, black water, reflection; dark heavy bottom half; wide.
lakeshore buildings night reflection, Viettel sign; generic.
Ngọc Sơn gate night, lit dragons; nice colour, crop tight.
Ngọc Sơn pavilion night, woman sitting alone in warm light, lake behind; small figure moment; branch top left. Strong.
bonsai under pavilion night, red columns, lake; good light. Similar set w/ 7730.
lake night wide, lit trees reflection, Turtle tower far;
vertical twin-ish of 7746 / 7567; best of the "lit tree over lake" set? 7567 has people + path; pick 7746E.
Huc bridge + Ngọc Sơn across lake, reflections; wide, empty sky top 40%.
vertical version with branch; meh.
Turtle Tower night, skyscraper reflections; clean, sharp?; lots of empty sky/water.

frames.focusAt: Turtle Tower sharp; the couple smeared at 100% (night, slight shake or missed focus). Fine at display size.
frames.critique: A couple on the bank facing the lit Turtle Tower, framed by trees and reflections. The best story frame in Hanoi. At 100% the tower is sharp and the couple is not: a miss on the moment that matters, fine at display size. Not a 5 for that reason.
skyline across lake framed by branches, pink building;
horizontal twin, plainer.
roundabout night, motorbike blur; ok street energy, lots of empty sky.
Ma Mây street at night, cafe chairs, lanterns; nice street life. No-entry sign centre.
rooftop view over Hoàn Kiếm at night, red bridge; establishing shot! Sky empty dark; haze. Good as city establishing.
cruise ship + tender beside karst, bird; arrival-day establishing, flat grey light.
green fishing boat w/ flag under karst wall at dusk, pink sky; strong vertical, small subject well placed.
anchored cruise boats at dusk, lit; calm, a bit grey.
night boats lights reflection; noisy, karsts barely visible.
sunrise silhouettes, mackerel sky purple, boats; good sky but dark left half mush.
vertical sunrise, mackerel sky glowing, boats; better than 8010 (8010/8015 -> 8015).
karst pair, pink sky, lit faces at first light; clean classic bay view. Yellow marker left.
tele: cruise boat + tender against karst, pink haze; quiet, pastel.
fishing boat entering bay among karst layers, pink; strong depth. Twin family w/ 8016.
sunrise sky streak, karst line, boat right; wide.
twin of 8031 with bird, boats; 8031 vs 8038 toss-up -> 8038 (bird + more boats? sky more colour).
A kite in a mackerel sky over karst silhouettes, vertical. The bird is crisp. A graphic variation on the dawn run.
soju bottle on deck, karst bokeh; fun, Korean soju; a "story" frame; shallow focus intended.
sunrise karst line, one small boat; plainer twin of 8031.

tele boat under huge grey cliff, red buoy; scale; 8055 better.
red/green fishing boat with flag, karst left, golden light; strong.
cruise boat silhouetted at dusk between karsts; ok.
vertical sun behind cloud, boats; similar to 8080.
tele peach sky, karst gap, two tiny boats; minimal, lovely.
three-masted "pirate" cruise ship + small fishing boat, pink sky; fun contrast.
tele haze karst layers, two boats; pale/flat, hazy.
sun behind cloud over dark haystack karst silhouette, tiny boat; heavy dark mass, ok.
cruise boat at foot of sunlit karst, blue; clean, golden side light.
sun over sea, sun path; generic.
sun over karst silhouettes, sun path on water; golden, classic. Sun clipped (expected).
vertical: sun, cliff edge right, islets; strong.
haystack karst silhouette, sun right, sun glitter, cloud top-left; strong composition.
sunlit karst w/ lone rower wake, blue sky popcorn clouds; morning, vivid.
twin of 8111 w/ cliff left; 8111 better.
dragon prow of boat facing karsts, morning; nice "aboard" frame but yellow prow dominant/odd.
tender boat interior, guide standing silhouette, tourists; documentary, people's faces; busy.
rower in nón lá standing in wooden boat, karst gate, boats beyond; best rowing frame.
rower with tourists in orange lifejackets, sun flare, railing foreground; railing intrudes.
twin, beam top-right intrudes, railing; 8171 better.
dog being petted on deck; cute, not for site.
floating fish farm, flag, karst; colourful documentary.
karst pillar + floating houses, reflection; good, vertical.

view out of cave mouth, rope right edge intrudes; ok.
boat sign HTX 16; record.
turquoise water, boat under cliff caves; colour a bit cyan-heavy.
rower in nón lá with two oars, karst gates, vertical; nice.
oar in foreground, tourists, cliff overhang; busy, faces.
rower standing, sunlit karst; tourists in lifejackets.

rower, temple/stupa left, karst gate; nice golden side light.
two women harvesting in water w/ lotus buds foreground; tele, soft-ish; nice moment.
river between karsts, boats small, haze/side light, lotus fields; establishing for the ride.
sunstar over karst, reeds backlit; flare, ok.
vertical: boats tiny under huge green karst wall, haze; scale, good.
Two egrets behind pink lotus buds, telephoto. Pretty, slightly soft overall at 1000px (not cropped).
river with shrine under cliff right; pleasant, plain.
wide karst valley, lotus field; similar to 8330.
boat under banyan trees, rower; lush, flat light.

frames.focusAt: faces; slight motion on the working hand
frames.critique: two women in nón lá working on bamboo dyke, karst behind; real moment, good.
sunlit karst + bamboo fence in water; nice light, shadow heavy.
motorboat w/ karst, wake; green, blue sky.
under cave mouth looking out at trees, rower; ultrawide-ish, foreground water blurred/busy.
boats with rowers in nón lá crossing below big karst walls, lilies; best "ride" frame w/ people.
motion-blurred boat foreground; soft (motion) — miss. Drop.
tourist photographing from boat, reflection; human, plain.
sunlit cliff face, boat tiny at base, reflection; scale.

The rower in nón lá rowing with her feet, karsts and the river behind. The face is sharp, the light is low and warm, and it says Tam Cốc better than any landscape. Proposed 5; check against the existing 5s.
inside cave looking out: stalactite ceiling frames sunlit karst, rocks in water; strong frame. Dark top heavy.
silhouetted boats returning at dusk, karst; low light, a bit flat.
pier at sunset: sun, rows of green boats, rower w/ passenger in white, drone in sky (!), branch top-right; busy but great light.
sunset over pier lake, moored boats, karst; nice, sun clipped left.
golden hour lake, boat with orange vests leaving, hotel; pleasant record.
silhouette framed by leaves, pink sky, karst; person bottom right; leaves busy, cable top.
string lights + branches, pink sky, karst reflection; lovely mood. Bulbs maybe soft-intended.
pink dusk at pier, boatman standing on boat, rowers in nón lá lined up; nice blue-pink.

frames.focusAt: the woman in white áo dài in the boat, noisy at dusk
frames.critique: The pier at pink dusk: hundreds of moored boats, rowers in nón lá, a woman in white áo dài, the resort and palms against an orange-pink sky. Busy, but the busyness is the place. Proposed 5; check against the existing 5s.
magenta sky, Emeralda resort sign (brand), silhouettes; sky gorgeous but resort-heavy; sign glow cyan.
blue hour pier, purple sky, rowers in nón lá w/ lanterns, drone in sky, worker right; strong, busy. 8549 vs 8572: different light, keep both?
